description: This file implements flow rule parsing, management, and classification for a Realtek switch driver within the Linux kernel. It includes functions for parsing flow rules, adding and deleting flows, configuring flow classification (flower), and setting up traffic control (tc) hooks specific to the switch hardware.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_parse_flow_rule(struct rtl838x_switch_priv * priv,struct flow_rule * rule,struct rtl83xx_flow * flow)
methods.description: Parses a flow rule and extracts matching conditions such as protocols, VLAN, MAC addresses, and IP addresses into the flow structure.

methods.name: void rtl83xx_flow_bypass_all(struct rtl83xx_flow * flow)
methods.description: Sets the flow rule to bypass all processing, effectively disabling specific flow matching.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_parse_fwd(struct rtl838x_switch_priv * priv,const struct flow_action_entry * act,struct rtl83xx_flow * flow)
methods.description: Parses flow forwarding actions to determine the target port and updates the flow rule accordingly.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_add_flow(struct rtl838x_switch_priv * priv,struct flow_cls_offload * f,struct rtl83xx_flow * flow)
methods.description: Adds a new flow rule to the hardware switch, parsing the flow rule, applying actions like drop, redirect, VLAN manipulation, and updating the hardware rule table.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_configure_flower(struct rtl838x_switch_priv * priv,struct flow_cls_offload * f)
methods.description: Handles the configuration of flow classification rules (flower), managing addition and conflicts within the hash table.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_delete_flower(struct rtl838x_switch_priv * priv,struct flow_cls_offload * cls_flower)
methods.description: Removes a flow classification rule based on the cookie from the hardware switch.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_stats_flower(struct rtl838x_switch_priv * priv,struct flow_cls_offload * cls_flower)
methods.description: Collects statistics for a specific flow rule, such as packet counters.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_setup_tc_cls_flower(struct rtl838x_switch_priv * priv,struct flow_cls_offload * cls_flower)
methods.description: Dispatches commands for configuring, destroying, or querying stats for flow classification rules.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_setup_tc_block_cb(enum tc_setup_type type,void * type_data,void * cb_priv)
methods.description: Callback for setting up traffic control blocks, currently handles flower classifier setup.

methods.name: int rtl83xx_setup_tc(struct net_device * dev,enum tc_setup_type type,void * type_data)
methods.description: Main entry point for setting up traffic control rules on a device; initializes hash tables and registers classifiers.

ctags.signature: (struct rtl838x_switch_priv * priv,struct flow_cls_offload * f,struct rtl83xx_flow * flow)

ctags.name: rtl83xx_parse_flow_rule
ctags.signature: (struct rtl838x_switch_priv * priv,struct flow_rule * rule,struct rtl83xx_flow * flow)

ctags.name: rtl83xx_parse_fwd
ctags.signature: (struct rtl838x_switch_priv * priv,const struct flow_action_entry * act,struct rtl83xx_flow * flow)
